bone_ring.name: BONE RING
bone_ring.description: A finger bone set in tarnished iron. It sharpens the eye.

ember_ring.name: EMBER RING
ember_ring.description: A coal trapped in silver. Its heat never fades.

void_signet.name: VOID SIGNET
void_signet.description: A seal from a forgotten order. It drinks the dark.

ashen_pendant.name: ASHEN PENDANT
ashen_pendant.description: A small charm of ash and bone. It steadies the heart.

warden_talisman.name: WARDEN TALISMAN
warden_talisman.description: A ward against the risen. Scratched, but still holding.

shroud_of_dusk.name: SHROUD OF DUSK
shroud_of_dusk.description: A chain of woven shadow. The veil leans closer to listen.
